extractions.description: The paper introduces Contractive Diffusion Policies (CDPs), adding a contraction loss on the score Jacobian of the reverse diffusion ODE for offline policy learning. It provides theoretical analysis and empirical evaluation on D4RL offline RL benchmarks, Robomimic imitation learning benchmarks (low-dim and image observations), and physical Franka robot manipulation tasks.

type.quote: We evaluate CDPs for offline learning by conducting extensive experiments in simulation and real world settings.
type.justification: The paper includes theory but its core claims are validated through extensive simulated and real-robot experiments.
